title: byte(value) truncates toward zero then checks 0..255
purpose: Observe the values produced by the operation.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 6.1: byte() accepts int/byte/float/rat, truncates toward zero then checks 0..255 (255.9 -> 255, -0.5 -> 0, 511/2 -> 255).
